annotations.title: Create a subscription or instalment plan

description: Bill a customer every day/week/month/year. Invoice 0 is issued at once: send its hosted_invoice_url (in latest_invoice) to the customer. Set billing_cycles (2–24) for an instalment plan that ends by itself.

billing_cycles.description: Instalment plan: number of payments; omit for an open-ended subscription

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.
